text:
Sara Lopez: Heads-up: we're kicking off the Azure DevOps -> GitHub Actions migration next week. Migration doc + timeline here: https://go/redwood/azdo-gh-migration. Key goals: consolidate pipelines, retire old SPNs, standardize self-hosted runner labels, and move artifact storage to GH Packages.
Mike Chen: Thanks — what's the cutover window?
Sara Lopez: Planning two windows: a low-risk dry-run Fri 2026-04-03 02:00-04:00 UTC, and the actual cutover Sat 2026-04-11 01:00-05:00 UTC. Both in the doc.
Jessica Patel: Will we have rollback steps if a pipeline fails?
Sara Lopez: Yes — each pipeline will have a canary branch in GH and a revert job. Instructions under "rollback" in the doc. Also automatic fallback to hosted runners if self-hosted goes unhealthy.
Alvaro Cruz: Runner capacity — are we pre-provisioning more self-hosted runners for peak builds?
Sara Lopez: Yes. We'll add +30% runner pool for the first two weeks. Mike is owner for autoscaling scripts.
Mike Chen: noted. I'll update the autoscaler and post the new runner AMI snapshot in #eng-infra.
Ria Gomez: Question about secrets: currently some pipelines use AzDO variable groups. Are we rotating those into Vault and GH Secrets?
Sara Lopez: Correct. All secrets must be in Hashi Vault (transit->GH secrets sync). See the "secrets-migration" section. We will rotate SPN credentials and create GitHub App installations for service-to-service auth.
Jessica Patel: Any changes to Jira links / deployment statuses? We rely on AzDO build status to update Jira.
Sara Lopez: Good catch — we added a GH Actions to Jira bridge. Workflows need the jira/deploy-status step. Example YAML in the doc:```yamlname: ci-on-pushon: [push]jobs:deploy:steps:- uses: actions/checkout@v3- name: Jira Status - uses: redwood/actions-jira@v1  with:  status: success```
Mike Chen: CI linting and caching? Will cache keys change?
Sara Lopez: Cache keys will include `gh-actions` prefix. See caching migration snippet. Old AzDO caches will be available for 30 days before GC.
ci-bot: NOTE: Please run `./scripts/check-pipelines.sh` against your repos by 2026-03-30 to surface incompatible tasks.
Alvaro Cruz: I ran the script on infra repos — found two uses of AzCLI tasks that need rewriting. I'll PR fixes before the dry-run.
Ria Gomez: Who's the escalation contact during cutover?
Sara Lopez: Pager rota: Mike Chen (primary), Jessica Patel (secondary), Alvaro Cruz (on-call for infra). DM me if you need to swap. @here please ack if you have PRs pending for migration.
Mike Chen: ack :thumbsup:
Jessica Patel: ack
Alvaro Cruz: ack
Sara Lopez: Final note: PATs will be deprecated for CI by 2026-05-01. Migrate to GitHub App tokens or OIDC where possible. See the "auth" subsection.
deploy-bot: Deploy plan created: migration-plan-v1. Link: https://ci.redwood/migrations/1835104321
Sara Lopez: If you have service accounts that cannot use GH App/OIDC, file a ticket in #help with justification and owner.
Ria Gomez: I'll open the ticket for the legacy deployment scripts we still run.
Sara Lopez: Thanks all — we'll do a short pre-cutover sync Mon 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC. Agenda in calendar invite.
